plan.title: F5/F6 Stage B - Populate duration, dimensions and codec (slow)

narratives.Overview: Populate the expensive half from AVFoundation during scan, plus eager backfill. Serves Inspector display reads from SQLite instead of reopening files.
narratives.Problem: There are 12 AVURLAsset( construction sites -- InspectorView.swift:1010 and :1026, DuplicateDetectionView.swift:273, AppComponents.swift:76, EditVideoView.swift:256, plus ContactSheetService, VideoEditingService and VideoTransferService. Duration, tracks, natural size and preferred transform are re-parsed from container atoms on hover and selection.
narratives.Action: Populate during scan; read from SQLite for display. Editing and transcoding paths continue constructing assets as needed -- only DISPLAY reads are served from the database.
narratives.Risk: This stage opens ~1,300 files and parses headers, so it is materially slower than Stage A and its cost is codec-dependent; damaged or exotic files may fail. Because the migration already added the columns, this stage can be deferred or made lazy without any schema change -- the columns simply stay null.
